statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
Claim diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.5
Mobile cardiac telemetry CPT 93229 was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management of the dual rhythm disturbance
The denial reason is CO-197 concerning missing prior authorization
